page_description: Create tagged links (UTM parameters) so each influencer's traffic shows up as its own campaign in Google Analytics.
source_help: utm_source — where the traffic originates (platform or the influencer's tracking handle).
campaign_name_help: utm_campaign — the promotion or strategic campaign.
campaign_id_help: utm_id — ties this link to a specific ad / campaign record.
content_help: utm_content — distinguishes links / creatives that point to the same URL.
influencer_note: Stored with the link so it can be shared with the influencer later. Not added to the URL.
paste_url_placeholder: Paste an existing UTM link to fill the form…
toast_paste_filled: Form filled from the pasted link
toast_paste_invalid: That doesn't look like a link with UTM parameters
generated_url_empty: Fill in the required fields to see the link…
decoded_note: Shown decoded for readability. Copy & Open use the percent-encoded URL.
search_links_placeholder: Search by influencer, UTM name, source…
no_links_description: Build a link and save it to share with an influencer.
delete_dialog_message: Remove this UTM link? This permanently deletes it.
toast_save_failed: Could not save the UTM link
toast_update_failed: Could not update the UTM link
toast_duplicated: Copied as a new link — set the UTM name and influencer
